attorneys: Solicitor General Jackson and Mr. Charles Fahy for petitioner., Messrs. Scott M. Lojtin, Jno. P. Stokes, and Harold B. Wahl for respondent., By leave of Court, Mr. Charlton Ogburn filed a brief on behalf of the American Federation of Labor, as amicus curiae, in support of respondent.
